description: This file defines the core Clipboard class and related functions for accessing and manipulating the system clipboard across different platforms within the Kivy framework. It includes platform-specific clipboard implementations and utility methods for copying and pasting data.

classes.name: ClipboardBase
classes.description: Base class providing an interface for clipboard operations, with platform-specific initialization and methods for copying and pasting data.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieve data from the clipboard in a specified mimetype.

methods.name: put
methods.description: Place data into the clipboard with an associated mimetype.

methods.name: get_types
methods.description: Return a list of supported mimetypes for the clipboard.

methods.name: _ensure_clipboard
methods.description: Initialize clipboard settings based on the current platform.

methods.name: copy
methods.description: Copy data to the clipboard, converting to string if necessary.

methods.name: paste
methods.description: Retrieve text data from the clipboard as a string.

methods.name: _copy
methods.description: Internal method to copy data, ensuring clipboard is initialized.

methods.name: _paste
methods.description: Internal method to retrieve and decode clipboard data.
